study type: Multicenter controlled before and after cohort study
exposure: history of a previous cesarean section (CS)
counselling with a decision aid (DA) including a prediction model
outcome: Practice variation in trial of labor rates
cohort: Women with a previous cesarean section (n=1,364)
finding: Nationwide implementation of counseling with a decision aid for women with a previous cesarean section significantly reduced practice variation in trial of labor rates without increasing cesarean section rates or complications.
mod_finding: Nationwide implementation of counseling with a decision aid for women with a previous cesarean section significantly reduced practice variation in trial of labor rates without increasing cesarean section rates.
